title: Flux as a Codec: Zero-Shot Lossy Compression with Flux
abstract: arXiv:2611.07929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose FluxC, a zero-shot codec that uses Flux as a compression prior. Although DiffC has shown that pretrained diffusion models can serve as zero-shot codecs, we ask how the choice of coding path and reconstruction method affects rate--distortion--perception behavior. We analyze FluxC along three axes: coding cost and bit allocation, reconstruction method, and low rate distortion. At matched signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), we show that the path choice does not affect the ideal information rate, but changes how bits are allocated across time steps. For reconstruction, we compare ancestral sampling, one-step ODE reconstruction, and many-step ODE reconstruction. Our analysis shows that ODE-based reconstruction can achieve lower distortion than ancestral sampling, especially in the low rate regime. translated_title: Flux 作为编解码器：基于 Flux 的零样本有损压缩
translated_abstract: 我们提出 FluxC，一种以 Flux 作为压缩先验的零样本编解码器。尽管 DiffC 已经证明预训练扩散模型可以充当零样本编解码器，我们探究了编码路径和重建方法的选择如何影响率-失真-感知行为。我们从三个维度对 FluxC 进行分析：编码成本与比特分配、重建方法以及低码率下的失真。在匹配信噪比（SNR）的条件下，我们表明路径选择不影响理想信息率，但会改变比特在各时间步之间的分配方式。在重建方面，我们比较了祖先采样、单步 ODE 重建和多步 ODE 重建。分析表明，基于 ODE 的重建能够比祖先采样实现更低的失真，尤其是在低码率区间。在高斯源和自然图像上的实验验证了这一预测。此外，FluxC 的性能与现有方法相当，在某些情况下甚至更优。
tldr: 本文提出 FluxC，一种以 Flux 为压缩先验的零样本编解码器，通过系统分析编码路径与重建方法对率-失真-感知性能的影响，发现基于 ODE 的重建在低码率下失真更低，整体性能可与现有方法竞争甚至超越。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FluxC, a zero-shot codec that uses Flux as a compression prior, and systematically analyzes how coding path choice and reconstruction methods affect rate-distortion-perception behavior, showing that ODE-based reconstruction achieves lower distortion than ancestral sampling, especially in the low-rate regime.
